mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quota_activity (name, ruleText, startTime, endTime, totalStock, grantAmount) VALUES (#{name}, #{ruleText}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{totalStock}, #{grantAmount})
mapper.select: SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(memberExpireAt) FROM `user` WHERE id = #{userId} AND isDelete = 0
SELECT activityId, claimNo, CASE status WHEN 'granted' THEN 'GRANTED' ELSE 'PROCESSING' END AS status FROM quota_claim WHERE activityId = #{id} AND userId = #{userId}
SELECT id FROM quota_activity WHERE status = 'published' AND id > #{cursor} ORDER BY id LIMIT 64
